availability.crossesEvenQuietHoursAlways: Crosses even quiet hours. Always logged as after-hours. Use only if it truly can't wait.
availability.overridesSOffStatusFlagged: Overrides {helperName}'s Off status. Flagged, logged, and counted as rest owed.
availability.reachingOffHoursIsReserved: Reaching {helperName} off-hours is reserved for on-site admins (Primary or Co-manager). As a remote admin you can queue this for {helperName2}'s next shift.
availability.offShiftSuggest: {name} is off shift. Add it as a task suggestion, and an on-site manager can decide.
availability.usuallyGoesTo: This usually goes to the {station}. Sending to {name} ({current}) instead. Pick {other} in the recipient list if that's who you meant.
availability.wentAsSuggestion: {name} is off shift, so it went to the on-site managers as a suggestion.
availability.nobodyAssignedSuggestion: Nobody is assigned, so it went to the on-site managers as a suggestion.
